name: freeze-frame-prog-acoustic
idea: The lead is one bright steel-string acoustic, a small-body 1950s flat-top, fingerpicked fast in a sparkling early-70s progressive-rock intro figure with ringing open strings and harmonics. A warm Moog-style bass slides up under it just before 4 seconds. At 4 seconds everything freezes as in the 'to be continued' meme: a tape-stop, then a held low analog synth chord that swells into cinematic dread (sub pulses, detuned saw drone, a ticking clock-like synth sequence) under the reel. From about 17 seconds the drone pitches down and slows to silence by 20 seconds. Ask for it by period, gear and the freeze gesture, never by artist; instrumental, no vocals; exclude drums kit groove, EDM drop, trap, singing.

name: aero-nylon-bossa
idea: The lead is a soft-touch nylon-string classical guitar playing gentle bossa-nova chords and a little melody. Glassy late-2000s FM electric piano, bubbly synth plinks and a water-drop sparkle sit around it, like a mid-2000s console menu or a desktop-OS demo video on a blue sky. At 4 seconds the guitar is cut dead and a deep pitched-down echo of its last chord turns into a dark, slow cinematic synth bed with low strings and a heartbeat sub-kick under the reel. It all thins and slows to nothing by about 20 seconds. Write the style as a mood-plus-texture list (sunny, glossy, aqua, then cold), naming the instruments precisely; instrumental, no vocals; exclude EDM drop, trap, big pop chorus, singing.

name: folktronica-laptop-glitch
idea: The lead is a close-miked fingerpicked steel-string acoustic in an open tuning, with string squeaks and room sound, cut up and looped over crunchy early-2000s laptop beats, glitch clicks and a warm sine-wave synth pad: the early-2000s folktronica sound, homemade and sunny. At 4 seconds the glitches take over: the guitar loop stutters, slips and breaks apart into granular digital noise, and a cold cinematic synth drone with distant metallic hits builds under the reel. The beat drops out, the noise fades and the last stutter slows to silence by about 20 seconds. Ask by genre name, year range and production technique (sample chopping, granular stutter), not by artist; instrumental, no vocals; exclude EDM drop, trap hats, autotune, singing.

name: twinkle-emo-bedroom
idea: The lead is a lone bedroom guitarist on a cheap acoustic, tapping and fingerpicking bright 'twinkly' major-seventh arpeggios in the late-90s Midwest emo style that became a TikTok meme riff, recorded lo-fi with a soft cassette hiss. A small toy-keyboard synth doubles the melody up high. At 4 seconds the guitar plays one wrong, detuned chord and stops; a long reversed swell drops into slow cinematic dread with bowed low strings, a distorted sub drone and a dull war-drum boom every bar under the reel. It all decays and slows to silence by about 20 seconds. Ask for it as a short scene description of the performer and the room before the turn; instrumental, no vocals; exclude singing, screaming, full band, EDM drop, trap.
